pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into positions unless the initial tranche has traversed a minimum of 2.5x the maximum risk envelope in open profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero execution permitted during candles showing upper/lower wicks exceeding 40% of total range; require confirmed volume delta divergence.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing profit capture or scale-out execution automatically once floating profit crosses +$15.00 to prevent evaporation.
